Finite positions |v|<=1000, unit normals (|n|^2 in [0.98,1.02]), finite UVs |v|<=10000
POSITION min/max present and within 1e-4 of decoded data
Indices inside the vertex buffer and no degenerate triangles
Vertex normals lie in the front hemisphere of each triangle (winding agrees with normals)

Each primitive has a material with baseColorFactor in [0,1]
1..16 animations named from the 12 canonical clips, no duplicates

Key times: 2..256 keys starting at 0, strictly increasing, ending <= 10 s; unit quaternion keys

animation_integrity.explanation: Fraction of valid animations, capped by animation/skin findings.

artistic_coherence.explanation: Subjective category: requires rendered visual evidence (--visual-evidence). Not inferred from geometry statistics.

embodiment_compatibility.explanation: 0 when a required rule fails; otherwise 0.6 + 0.4 x fraction of recommendations met.

geometry_integrity.explanation: 1.0 minus a penalty per distinct geometry/buffer/scene/container defect code (critical 1.0, error 0.35, warning 0.1); capped at 0.5 when any error is present.

material_completeness.explanation: Fraction of the material checklist satisfied, capped by material findings.

runtime_complexity.explanation: 1.0 up to 50% of the tightest budget, falling linearly to 0 at 200%.

visual_reference_alignment.explanation: Subjective category: requires rendered visual evidence (--visual-evidence). Not inferred from geometry statistics.
